meta.title: Strategy registry, validation gates, correlation and luck removal
meta.core_claim: No strategy in this repo has been validated. The registry documents what would have to be true for one to be.

gates.name: Sample size
gates.rule: >= 200 settled bets before a strategy may appear on the leaderboard.
gates.why: Below ~200 bets a 55% hit rate and a 50% hit rate are statistically indistinguishable at 95% confidence.

gates.name: Holdout discipline
gates.rule: Parameters fixed on seasons 1..n-1, scored on an untouched season n. The holdout is used once.
gates.why: Prevents the backtest from being the model.

gates.name: Noise floor
gates.rule: Beats a permutation/null distribution at p < 0.05 over 10,000 shuffles.
gates.why: Separates signal from a lucky ordering of the same outcomes.

gates.name: Closing-line value
gates.rule: Positive closing-line value over the sample.
gates.why: CLV is the least noisy evidence of genuine edge.

gates.name: Vig survivorship
gates.rule: Positive return at -110 pricing; break-even is 52.38%.
gates.why: A strategy that only works at 0 vig does not work.

gates.name: Stability
gates.rule: Does not depend on one season, one team or one week (leave-one-out changes ROI by < 5 pts).
gates.why: A single outlier cluster is not an edge.

gates.name: Correlation control
gates.rule: Correlated legs are priced with a correlation-adjusted joint probability, not the product of marginals.
gates.why: Parlays that multiply marginals systematically overstate the true chance.

gates.name: Luck removal
gates.rule: Reported skill is computed after removing one-score games, garbage time and turnover-luck residuals.
gates.why: The brief asks for selectively skill-based strategies, not winning streaks.

strategies.name: Shrunk offense-vs-defense line
strategies.thesis: Teams whose scoring rate diverges from the league mean after shrinkage have an exploitable expected margin.
strategies.notes: The line model this repo ships (data/lines.json). No graded results exist, so every gate is not-run.

strategies.name: Rest/bye differential
strategies.thesis: Teams off a bye outperform their baseline in the following game.
strategies.notes: Blocked: the repo has the Week 10 bye list but no historical rest-vs-performance data.

strategies.name: Backup-exposure fade
strategies.thesis: When the official report rules out a high-pedigree starter and the listed backup is a late-round or undrafted player, the team under-performs its baseline.
strategies.notes: This is the brief's injury requirement turned into a testable hypothesis. 43 confirmed starter losses were logged this week; none are graded yet.

strategies.name: Offensive-line continuity
strategies.thesis: Multiple starting linemen out depresses offensive efficiency more than the market prices.
strategies.notes: Week 10 has usable cases (TEN Skoronski, NO Fuaga + McCoy, BUF Brown, HOU Rutledge). Not graded.

strategies.name: Two-leg correlated parlay: same-game QB/WR
strategies.thesis: A QB passing-yards over and his WR1 receiving-yards over are positively correlated; naive multiplication understates the joint probability.
strategies.notes: Blocked: no per-player game logs are in the repo, so rho cannot be estimated - only assumed. A parlay built on an assumed rho is not validated.

strategies.name: Three-leg team-total parlay
strategies.thesis: Team totals in the same game are negatively correlated through the game script; the market sometimes prices them as independent.
strategies.notes: Needs a same-game correlation estimate, which needs play-by-play. Not collected.

strategies.name: Player prop: RB volume vs. opponent run-defense
strategies.thesis: Backup-forced defensive front changes (see STR-03) shift RB efficiency.
strategies.notes: Blocked on per-player logs and defensive snap data.

strategies.name: Injury-report timing drift
strategies.thesis: Lines move systematically when a Friday designation lands; the drift is exploitable before close.
strategies.notes: Blocked: it needs historical odds, which this environment cannot access. This is the single most valuable unblocked dependency (see Q-04).

pairs.pair: QB passing yards over  <->  his WR1 receiving yards over
pairs.basis: not estimated - requires per-player game logs (not in repo)

pairs.pair: Team total over  <->  opponent team total under (same game)
Spread cover  <->  game total over (same game)
RB rushing yards over  <->  team total over

pairs.basis: independence is the defensible default when no shared mechanism is identified

correlation.demonstration_note: Two 55% legs. The naive product is 0.3025. Higher correlation raises the true joint probability of two 'over' legs, so multiplying marginals understates the parlay - which is why G7 exists.

luck_removal.title: Removing luck from the equation
luck_removal.principle: A strategy is only 'skill based' if its edge survives removing the outcomes that are mostly variance.

procedures.name: One-score-game exclusion
procedures.method: Recompute ROI excluding games decided by <= 8 points, then require the sign to hold.

procedures.name: Garbage-time strip
procedures.method: Recompute excluding plays in the final 5 minutes with a >= 17 point margin.

procedures.name: Turnover-luck regression
procedures.method: Model turnovers as a mean-reverting series and subtract the non-persistent component from team efficiency.

procedures.name: Permutation null
procedures.method: Shuffle outcomes 10,000 times within strata; keep the strategy only if it clears the 95th percentile.

procedures.name: Deflated Sharpe
procedures.method: Deflate the observed Sharpe ratio for the number of strategies tried (multiple-comparisons correction).

procedures.name: Bootstrap CI
procedures.method: 10,000-sample bootstrap of ROI; report the 5th-95th percentile band, not the point estimate.

luck_removal.multiple_comparisons_note: Eight strategies are registered here. Testing all eight and reporting the best one inflates the apparent edge; L5 exists specifically to deflate for that.

leaderboard.why: A leaderboard row requires settled, graded bets. Zero bets have been settled in this repo, so no strategy has a record.
what_would_fill_it: A settled-bet log with strategy id, market, price taken, closing price, stake and result.
At least 200 settled bets per strategy before a row is displayed (gate G1).
All eight gates recorded pass/fail with linked evidence.

reward_scheme.scoring: risk-adjusted: ROI / stdev of ROI, then deflated by the number of strategies tried (L5). Raw ROI is explicitly not the ranking metric.

tiers.reward: eligible for the smallest unit stake

tiers.requirement: G1..G8 pass on an out-of-sample season

reward_scheme.warning: The reward scheme is a proposal. It allocates no money and has no verified historical returns behind it.
